contamination: no stale/superseded marking: resume key is bare state_id membership. A checkpoint from an incompatible code/config version would be silently reused (same state_id, different science). Future design must version-stamp entries (kernel_identity + arm + seed + count).
description: P0 audit of results/v3/v3_8d/mc2_checkpoint.json semantics (frozen; not modified).
granularity: per state_id (per exact field state); full-field payloads (winner_frequency + full position_distribution + valid + fold_through + frame_index), NOT target-only
identity: bare state_id string (race|driver|lap); no config/kernel/seed version in the key
lookup: dict membership in an in-memory dict loaded once from JSON (O(1) per row); file rewritten every 5 rows
parallel_writers: NOT SUITABLE as-is: single shared JSON file with full-dict rewrites; concurrent writers would clobber. Future: per-worker files or single-writer merge, plus version-stamped keys.
reuse: completed simulations reusable across reruns of the same script only (crash resume); not reusable across states (keys are state-exact, correctly)
serialization: json.dump of the entire accumulated dict every 5 rows (~56 dumps to 1.3MB final); O(n^2) total bytes; minor at 277 rows
